head: Unscripted turns an iPhone or iPad into a party video booth
dek: Put Unscripted on a stand and tap Go Live: guests answer questions on camera, take photos and leave messages for the host. It was #92 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
details: It costs $0.99 with in-app purchases, by Anthony Waldner.
means: If you're hosting a party, it's a cheap guest book with video.
todo: Find Unscripted in the App Store.
